messages:
lea-sales: Onboarding update for Zenith POC — they report SSO fails and SCIM pushes create accounts without emails. Can we troubleshoot?
mike-solutions: @hana-iam can you look at the SCIM payloads they sent? quick check: 401 vs 400?
lee-customer: We saw 401 first, then after rotating the stored secret we see 400: "missing emails[0].value".
hana-iam: 401 is token mismatch. Confirm the SCIM token in their connector matches the token from Admin > Integrations > SCIM and header format is exactly `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
lee-customer: Confirmed we updated token from the Admin UI. After that the 400 appeared.
pet e-eng: (pet e typo)
pete-eng: For the 400, many IdPs map primary email to a different claim name. We require either `userName` or `emails[0].value`. Ask them to map `email` -> `emails[0].value` or include userName in the payload. Example we accept: `{\n  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],\n  "userName":"lee@zenith.example",\n  "emails":[{"value":"lee@zenith.example","primary":true}]\n}`
lea-sales: SAML side — Zenith saw "EntityDescriptor mismatch" when starting SSO. What entity ID do we expect for POC console?
hana-iam: POC tenants use `https://poc.redwood.ai/saml/sp`. If they configured the older value `https://app.redwood.ai/saml/metadata` that will fail. We can temporarily allow old value per-tenant if platform flips a config.
mike-solutions: I can request the per-tenant alias. Pete — can you apply a one-off to accept both while they update?
pete-eng: Yep, requested change cfg-99111. Waiting approval.
infra-bot: Config change requested: cfg-99111 by pete-eng. Status: pending.
lee-customer: After we corrected the token and updated Okta mapping to include emails, SCIM now returns 201 and 17 users created. SSO still failing until alias applied.
infra-bot: cfg-99111 approved and deployed at 2026-03-21T10:22:12Z.
lee-customer: Re-tested SSO after deploy — login succeeds. All good. Thanks.
lea-sales: Nice. Follow-ups: 1) mike to attach SCIM mapping snippet to the POC ticket, 2) hana to send one-paragraph on token rotation for their security team, 3) pete to note alias change in tenant config history.
hana-iam: Sent DM with token rotation blurb: "SCIM tokens are tenant-scoped API tokens created in the Redwood Admin console. Tokens can be rotated by the customer or support; rotating a token immediately invalidates prior tokens. Token usage is logged and available in audit exports."
lea-sales: Closing thread, will update the CRM.
